strings.name: Anitta
strings.summary: Born Larissa de Macedo Machado, Anitta developed through Rio church singing, dance and online performances. She connects Brazilian funk, pop and reggaeton through Portuguese, Spanish and English collaborations. Funk Generation foregrounded urban Brazilian music. Her 2026 album EQUILIBRIVM explored Brazilian culture and spirituality and earned her first Latin Grammy.
